crew.overview: War in Abkhazia, 1992. An Estonian man Ivo has stayed behind to harvest his crops of tangerines. In a bloody conflict at his door, a wounded man is left behind, and Ivo is forced to take him in.
crew.title: Tangerines

details.biography:
Rein Kotov (born February 17, 1965 in Raasiku, Harju County) is an Estonian cinematographer and film editor.

In 1991 he graduated from Gerasimov Institute of Cinematography. 1985-1993 he worked at Tallinnfilm. After that he has worked primarily for Allfilm.

In 2014 he was awarded with Order of the White Star, IV class.
details.name: Rein Kotov
details.place_of_birth: Raasiku, Harju County, Estonian SRR, USSR [now Estonia]
